guides.title: Badge of Justice vendors and daily-quest givers
guides.summary: Where Badges of Justice (item 29434) are spent and who hands out the badge-paying dailies. G'eras in Shattrath is the base vendor from Phase 1 and gains stronger stock in Phase 4; the Isle of Quel'Danas vendors (Smith Hauthaa, Kayri, Shaani) and their Shattrath mirrors (Anwehu, Ontuvo) arrive in Phase 5 behind the Shattered Sun Offensive island progression. Wind Trader Zhareem gives the heroic daily that pays 2 badges; Nether-Stalker Mah'duun gives the normal daily that pays an Ethereum Prison Key and no badges.
guides.unlocks: Knowing every counter that takes badges lets the player route a week of farming to the item they actually want.

phase.notes: G'eras from Phase 1 (expanded stock Phase 4). Isle of Quel'Danas vendors from Phase 5 and only after the realm's Shattered Sun Offensive effort reaches the relevant stage. Anniversary 2026 dates: P1 2026-02-05, P2 2026-05-14, P3 2026-08-27, P4 scheduled 2026-10-22, P5 TBA autumn 2026.

steps.title: Find G'eras on the Terrace of Light
steps.detail: G'eras is a naaru on the upper walkway of the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City (Questie spawn 50.8, 42.3; the wiki describes him as standing in the central dome and notes he was moved to the upper walkway in patch 2.4, which is the layout the 2.5.x client uses). He is the only badge vendor from Phase 1 to Phase 4. His launch stock is the 2.0 and 2.1 catalogue: trinkets at 41 badges (Icon of the Silver Crescent, Bloodlust Brooch, Essence of the Martyr), necklaces, rings, cloaks and off-hands at 25, shields at 33, Searing Sunblade at 50, class relics at 15, fire resistance pieces at 20 and 30, and Primal Nether at 10. In Phase 4 he adds the 2.3 and 2.4 Shattrath catalogue (helms 50, bracers 35, gloves, belts, boots and shoulders 60, legs and chests 75, Battlemaster trinkets 75, relics 20) and Nether Vortex at 15.

steps.title: Pick up the heroic daily from Wind Trader Zhareem
steps.detail: Wind Trader Zhareem stands in the Lower City outside the World's End Tavern (Questie spawn 75.1, 36.7), beside Nether-Stalker Mah'duun. He offers one random Wanted quest per day that must be completed on Heroic difficulty and pays 2 Badges of Justice plus about 13 to 25 gold and 350 reputation with the Consortium and the dungeon's faction. On the Anniversary realms the daily is available from Phase 1 (TBC Classic had it at launch too). The pool is 15 quests, one per heroic dungeon, and gains Magisters' Terrace (quest 11499) in Phase 5. You cannot hold two Wanted quests at once and the quest resets at the daily reset.

steps.title: Know that Mah'duun's normal daily pays no badges
steps.detail: Nether-Stalker Mah'duun stands next to Zhareem (Questie spawn 75.5, 37.2) and offers the non-heroic daily: kill a handful of named trash mobs in one of eight dungeons (quests 11364, 11371, 11376, 11383, 11385, 11387, 11389 and, from Phase 5, 11500). The reward is one Ethereum Prison Key, about 16 gold and 250 reputation with the Consortium and the dungeon's faction; it never pays Badges of Justice. It is still worth doing on the way to a heroic because the key opens Ethereum Prisons in Netherstorm and feeds the Mana-Tombs stasis chain that pays 5 badges once. Note that the task brief had the two NPCs the wrong way round; the quest text confirms Zhareem is the heroic (badge) daily and Mah'duun the normal one.

steps.title: Buy Sunwell-tier badge gear from Smith Hauthaa
steps.detail: Smith Hauthaa stands at her anvil behind the Sun's Reach Armory on the Isle of Quel'Danas (Questie spawn 50.6, 40.8). She is a Phase 5 vendor and is gated by the realm-wide Shattered Sun Offensive effort: she appears once the Sun's Reach Armory has been retaken (SSO stage 2 complete) and only starts selling once the Anvil and Forge behind the armory has been built by the realm completing the daily Making Ready (quest 11535), after which the follow-up daily Don't Stop Now.... (11536) keeps it running. Her catalogue is the 2.4 badge gear: chests and legs at 100 badges, belts, boots and gloves at 75, rings and necklaces at 60, two-handers and main weapons at 150, one-handers at 105 and off-hand weapons at 45. Anwehu in Shattrath mirrors her stock under the same gate.

steps.title: Use Anwehu in Shattrath as Hauthaa's mirror
steps.detail: Anwehu (added in patch 2.4.2) stands on the Terrace of Light behind Exarch Nasuun and the Shattrath portal to the Isle (Questie spawn 48.1, 42.9, matching the wiki's 48.1, 42.9). He sells exactly Smith Hauthaa's badge gear at the same prices and obeys the same gate: no sales until the realm has built the Anvil and Forge through Making Ready. Handy when you are already in Shattrath turning in the heroic daily. Ontuvo (npc 27666, 48.6, 40.9) next to him mirrors Shaani's epic gems at 15 badges each.

steps.title: Trade badges for Veteran's PvP pieces at Kayri
steps.detail: Kayri, Exotic Gear Purveyor, stands by the Sun's Reach Armory (Questie spawn 50.2, 39.8) and sells Veteran's (Season 2) belts and boots for 40 badges and bracers for 25 badges, the PvP waist, wrist and feet slots that are otherwise honour purchases. She is listed as available from Shattered Sun Offensive stage 3 (armory and harbour retaken). Good value for arena players who would rather spend badges than honour on these three slots.

steps.title: Buy uncut epic gems from Shaani for 15 badges
steps.detail: Shaani, Jewelcrafting Supplies, stands near the Sun's Reach Sanctum (Questie spawn 51.5, 32.5) and sells uncut epic gems (Crimson Spinel, Empyrean Sapphire, Lionseye, Shadowsong Amethyst, Pyrestone, Seaspray Emerald) for 15 badges each. She begins selling once the realm has retaken Sun's Reach Harbor and activated the Alchemy Lab (the wiki lists her as stage 4C). Ontuvo in Shattrath mirrors her stock. This is the cheapest reliable epic-gem source once badge gear is finished.

guides.title: Badges of Justice: Phase 1 weekly route
guides.summary: In Phase 1 the only renewable badge sources are heroic dungeon bosses (one badge each) and Wind Trader Zhareem's heroic daily (two badges). Karazhan, Gruul and Magtheridon drop no badges yet. A player who does the daily every day and laps the heroics can bank roughly 60 badges a week, enough for a 41-badge trinket and a 25-badge slot every fortnight.
guides.unlocks: G'eras's launch catalogue: 41-badge trinkets, 25-badge necks, rings, cloaks and off-hands, 33-badge shields and 10-badge Primal Nethers.

phase.notes: Anniversary Phase 1 began 2026-02-05 (TBC Classic 2021-06-01). This route is superseded by BADGES_PHASE_2 when Phase 2 opens; the sources themselves do not change until Phase 4.

steps.title: Do Zhareem's heroic daily: 2 badges
steps.questName: Wanted: (heroic boss item), one of fifteen
steps.detail: Each day Wind Trader Zhareem in Shattrath's Lower City offers one random Wanted quest that is completable only on Heroic difficulty and pays 2 Badges of Justice, gold and 350 reputation with the Consortium and the dungeon's faction. The pool is one quest per heroic: Nazan's Riding Crop (11354, Ramparts), Keli'dan's Feathered Stave (11362, Blood Furnace), Bladefist's Seal (11363, Shattered Halls), The Heart of Quagmirran (11368, Slave Pens), A Black Stalker Egg (11369, Underbog), The Warlord's Treatise (11370, Steamvault), The Headfeathers of Ikiss (11372, Sethekk), Shaffar's Wondrous Pendant (11373, Mana-Tombs), The Exarch's Soul Gem (11374, Auchenai Crypts), Murmur's Whisper (11375, Shadow Labyrinth), The Epoch Hunter's Head (11378, Old Hillsbrad), Aeonus's Hourglass (11382, Black Morass), A Warp Splinter Clipping (11384, Botanica), Pathaleon's Projector (11386, Mechanar) and The Scroll of Skyriss (11388, Arcatraz). The item drops from the end boss, so the daily is also a full heroic clear worth 2 to 5 more badges. Nether-Stalker Mah'duun's normal daily next to him pays an Ethereum Prison Key, not badges. Seven dailies a week is 14 badges on its own.

steps.title: Lap the heroics: 1 badge per boss
steps.detail: Every boss in a heroic dungeon drops exactly one Badge of Justice for each player, and each heroic can be entered once per day per character. Full-clear totals: Ramparts 3, Blood Furnace 3, Shattered Halls 4 (5 if the Shattered Hand Executioner is killed before he executes the prisoners), Slave Pens 3, Underbog 4, Steamvault 3, Mana-Tombs 3 (4 with Yor), Auchenai Crypts 2, Sethekk Halls 2 (3 with Anzu), Shadow Labyrinth 4, Old Hillsbrad 3, Black Morass 3, Mechanar 4, Botanica 5 and Arcatraz 4, which is 50 badges for one lap of all fifteen or 53 with the bonus bosses. In Phase 1 heroic keys still need Revered with the dungeon's faction (Honor Hold or Thrallmar, Cenarion Expedition, Lower City, Keepers of Time, the Sha'tar). Pick the dungeons with the most badges per hour: Mechanar, Botanica, Shattered Halls, Underbog, Shadow Labyrinth and Arcatraz.

steps.title: Clear heroic Mechanar: 4 badges
steps.detail: The Mechanar is the fastest heroic for a geared five: Gatewatcher Gyro-Kill, Gatewatcher Iron-Hand, Nethermancer Sepethrea and Pathaleon the Calculator each drop a badge, four in about half an hour. Entry needs the Warpforged Key from the Sha'tar. Pathaleon's Projector (daily 11386) drops from the last boss. Bring interrupts for the Sunseeker Astromages and kill the Legion Cache groups cleanly before the Sepethrea stairs.

steps.title: Clear heroic Botanica: 5 badges
steps.detail: The Botanica has five bosses (Commander Sarannis, High Botanist Freywinn, Thorngrin the Tender, Laj, Warp Splinter), the most badges of any heroic, though the long corridors make it slower than Mechanar. A Warp Splinter Clipping (daily 11384) drops from Warp Splinter. Crowd control the Sunseeker Gene-Splicers and keep the tank away from Thorngrin's Sacrifice. Sha'tar Revered (Phase 1 to 3) for the Warpforged Key.

steps.title: Clear heroic Shattered Halls: 4 badges (5 with the Executioner)

steps.title: Add the three optional bosses: Yor, Anzu, the Executioner

Anzu in heroic Sethekk Halls is summoned by a druid who has completed the Swift Flight Form chain and drops a badge. The Shattered Hand Executioner in heroic Shattered Halls drops a badge when killed before the hostages are executed. Each is worth one badge per run on top of the dungeon's total.

Use the Mana-Tombs Stasis Chamber Key (item 32069) on the chamber behind Shaffar in heroic Mana-Tombs, kill Yor, and turn in for 5 Badges of Justice and 500 Consortium reputation. Ethereum Prison Keys from Mah'duun's normal daily and Netherstorm drops feed the chain. It is a one-time payout available from Phase 1.

steps.title: Spend: what to buy first in Phase 1
steps.detail: G'eras's Phase 1 catalogue is the 2.0 and 2.1 stock. Buy the 41-badge trinket for your role first (Icon of the Silver Crescent for casters, Bloodlust Brooch for melee and hunters, Essence of the Martyr for healers), because trinkets are the slots Karazhan fills worst. Next the 25-badge pieces that beat your pre-raid item: necklaces (Manasurge Pendant, Necklace of the Juggernaut, Choker of Vile Intent, Necklace of Eternal Hope, Brooch of Deftness), rings (Ring of Cryptic Dreams, Band of Halos, Ring of Arathi Warlords, Ring of Unyielding Force), cloaks (Bishop's Cloak, Blood Knight War Cloak, Farstrider Defender's Cloak) and off-hands (Talisman of Kalecgos, Orb of the Soul-Eater, Khadgar's Knapsack, Tears of Heaven, Sapphiron's Wing Bone, Fetish of the Primal Gods, Flametongue Seal, Voodoo Shaker). Shields are 33 (Azure-Shield of Coldarra, Light-Bearer's Faith Shield, Mazthoril Honor Shield), Searing Sunblade 50 and Gnomeregan Auto-Blocker 600 41. Primal Nether is 10 badges; only buy it when a crafted epic is waiting on it. Fire resistance sets (20 per hands and feet, 30 per chest and legs) are not needed until Hyjal and Black Temple.

steps.detail: G'eras now sells the 2.3 and 2.4 Shattrath catalogue. Buy in order of slot value: 75-badge legs (Shifting Camouflage Pants, Natural Life Leggings, Pantaloons of Arcane Annihilation, Achromic Trousers of the Naaru, High Justicar's Legplates, Unwavering Legguards, Bloodthirster's Wargreaves, Shallow-grave Trousers, Pants of Splendid Recovery, Blessed Elunite Coverings, Vestments of Hibernation) and 75-badge chests (Chestguard of the Stoic Guardian, Hauberk of the Furious Elements), then 50-badge helms (Cowl of Naaru Blessings, Mana-Binders Cowl, Warpstalker Helm, Storm Master's Helmet, Mask of the Deceiver, Cowl of Beastly Rage, Faceguard of Determination, Helmet of the Steadfast Champion), then 60-badge boots, belts, gloves and shoulders (Treads of the Life Path, Iron-tusk Girdle, Gauntlets of Sniping, Gnarled Ironwood Pauldrons and the rest), 35-badge bracers, 35-badge Brooch of Deftness and the 75-badge Battlemaster trinkets for PvP. Relics (Idol of Terror, Libram of Divine Purpose, Totem of Living Water, Skycall Totem and others) are 20. Nether Vortex at 15 badges unblocks Tier 6 era crafting and is no longer soulbound, so buying for guild crafters is sensible. Only buy from the launch stock (41 trinkets, 25 slots) where it still beats your raid gear.

guides.title: Badges of Justice: Phase 5 weekly route
guides.summary: Phase 5 (Fury of the Sunwell) finishes the badge economy: Mount Hyjal, Black Temple and Sunwell Plateau bosses drop badges, heroic Magisters' Terrace adds four more and joins the heroic daily pool, and the Isle of Quel'Danas vendors Smith Hauthaa, Kayri and Shaani (mirrored in Shattrath by Anwehu and Ontuvo) open behind the Shattered Sun Offensive progression. A full raid week is now worth well over a hundred badges, and the 100-badge chests and 150-badge weapons are the end of the road.
guides.unlocks: Smith Hauthaa's Sunwell-tier badge gear (chests and legs 100, belts, boots and gloves 75, rings and necks 60, weapons 150, 105 and 45), Kayri's Veteran's PvP pieces (40 and 25) and Shaani's epic gems (15).

Buy the 100-badge chest or legs that beats your Tier 6 piece first, then the 150-badge weapon if Sunwell is not dropping yours, then 75-badge slots. Kayri's Veteran's belts and boots (40) and bracers (25) cover PvP slots, and Shaani or Ontuvo sell uncut epic gems at 15 each, the best use of leftover badges once gear is done. G'eras's Phase 4 catalogue (75 legs and chests, 50 helms) remains the cheaper fill for alts.

verify.verdict: All 128 cited ids resolve to their claimed names and coordinates on the Anniversary endpoint, but the guide has real structural errors: quest 10977 opens the front stasis chamber (Ambassador Pax'ivi), not Yor's; the Zul'Aman badge-quest prerequisite is Promises, Promises... (11132) not A Troll Among Trolls; SSC/TK attunement ended in Phase 3 not 4; Karazhan was never a Phase 4 attunement change; Brooch of Deftness, Fetish of the Primal Gods and Voodoo Shaker are 35-badge Phase 4 stock, not 25-badge Phase 1; Karazhan and Zul'Aman per-boss badge splits are wrong (totals right); the Shartuul badges are a 3.0.2 addition; two Supplies dailies (11516, 11877) are missing; Kayri's gate is the Armory, not the Harbor.
verify.notes: Method: every npc/item/quest id in the task list and in the guide JSON (128 ids: 12 vendor/quest-giver NPCs, 67 boss NPCs, 4 items, 45 quests) was fetched from https://nether.wowhead.com/tooltip/<kind>/<id>?dataEnv=5&locale=0 with a 0.3 s sleep; raw JSON is in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Applications-World-of-Warcraft--anniversary--Interface-AddOns/105233e8-fb20-4d89-9f2e-abe18c8d8218/scratchpad/factcheck/raw/ and the comparison script is parse.py there. Name matches: 128/128 (the seven unnamed Mah'duun dailies 11364/11371/11376/11383/11385/11387/11389 resolve to Wanted: Shattered Hand Centurions / Coilfang Myrmidons / Malicious Instructors / Rift Lords / Sunseeker Channelers / Tempest-Forge Destroyers / Arcatraz Sentinels, i.e. the 8-dungeon normal pool with 11500).
